title: ALMA-JELLY. I. High Resolution CO(2─1) Observations of Ongoing Ram Pressure Stripping in NGC 4858 Reveal Asymmetrical Gas Tail Formation and Fallback
question: How do strong, highly-inclined ram pressure stripping, rotation and torques shape the asymmetric inner molecular gas tail of NGC 4858, and is there evidence for gas fallback?

what.value: Stellar mass, SFR, HI mass of NGC 4858

evidence.quote: (6,7,8): Stellar mass, star formation rate measured using NUV and $22\mu m$ luminosity, and HI gas mass estimates from (cite: molnar_westerbork_2022).
Ground-based R-band and narrow-band (H$\alpha$ at the Coma cluster) images of NGC 4858 come from (cite: yagi_dozen_2010)
We model the Coma cluster mass distribution as an NFW profile with a total mass of $1.2\times10^{15}M_\odot$, with a concentration ($c=R_\text{vir}/R_s =9$) (cite: lokas_dark_2003).

recipe.goal: Image CO cube and make moment maps
recipe.method: PHANGS-ALMA pipeline tclean multi-scale with masks, natural weighting; masks and moment maps with MASKMOMENT
key_parameters: robust=2; 3.8 km/s channels; >3 sigma in 2 contiguous channels

recipe.goal: Derive CO flux, luminosity and H2 mass
recipe.method: Integrate moment-0; L'CO from Solomon et al. formula; MH2 = alphaCO/R21 L'CO
assumptions: R21 ~0.8; alphaCO = 4.3 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1; DL = 100 Mpc

recipe.goal: Characterize stellar disk (PA, ellipticity, inclination, Sersic)
recipe.method: Elliptical isophote fitting of Subaru R-band image and 1D Sersic fit; same for CO moment-0 profile
key_parameters: Northern region heavily masked to avoid NGC 4860 light

recipe.goal: Azimuthal/quadrant analysis of CO distribution and tail angle
recipe.method: Elliptical annuli with stellar PA/ellipticity; median flux in theta +/-5 deg; tail angle from LOFAR flux bisection; four quadrants
key_parameters: theta_wind = -15 deg equally divides radio flux at 18-27 kpc

recipe.goal: Fit circular rotation model and obtain velocity residuals
recipe.method: 3DBarolo on moment-1 with fixed stellar PA, inclination, centre, Vsys; extend with tanh rotation curve; subtract model from moment-1
key_parameters: Vmax = 165 km/s from Tully-Fisher; rt free, best fit 2.4 kpc
assumptions: Motions in disk plane; tail in front of the disk

recipe.method: Geometric dot product of wind and disk normal vectors using theta_tail, theta_maj, i and total velocity from GALA NFW orbit estimate
key_parameters: Vtot = 3410 km/s; uncertainty = Coma velocity dispersion
assumptions: Projected distance equals true distance to cluster centre; NFW with M=1.2e15, c=9

recipe.goal: Compare with simulations and evaluate torque asymmetry
recipe.method: Differential ram pressure R formula; qualitative comparison to simulation snapshots

evidence.quote: This corresponds to an inclination of $38\degree$.

evidence.loc: 4 CO Distribution & Comparisons with Other Wavelengths

answer_key.quantity: Fraction of CO flux beyond leading-side truncation (inner tail)

evidence.loc: 4 CO Distribution & Comparisons with Other Wavelengths
evidence.quote: 14% of the total CO emission is located beyond the southern side truncation radius
